summary: 广传的“7–38–55”比例来自研究态度和感受的特定实验。作者检查实验怎样组合、样本和情境有什么限制，再解释教材如何把结果推广过度。

paragraphs.brief: Albert Mehrabian及其在1967年加州大学洛杉矶分校的同事对通信中的口头和非口头信息进行研究的结果经常被引用，现在往往被视为不言自明的事实。
sentences: The findings of a study on verbal and non-verbal messages in communication by Albert Mehrabian and his colleagues at UCLA in 1967 have been quoted so frequently that they are now often regarded as a self-evident truth.
Albert Mehrabian及其在1967年加州大学洛杉矶分校的同事对通信中的口头和非口头信息进行研究的结果经常被引用，现在往往被视为不言自明的事实。

paragraphs.brief: 在第一次实验中，请各主体聆听一女的录音，用三个音调表示“可能”一词，以表达对她的喜好、中立和不满。
sentences: In the first experiment, subjects were asked to listen to a recording of a female saying the word “maybe” in three tones of voice to convey liking, neutrality, and disliking.
在第一次实验中，请各主体聆听一女的录音，用三个音调表示“可能”一词，以表达对她的喜好、中立和不满。
The subjects were then shown photos of female faces expressing the same three emotions and were asked to guess the emotions in the recorded voice and the photos.
然后向这些主题展示了女性脸部的照片，表达同样的三种情绪，并被要求猜测录音音和照片中的情绪。
It was found that the photos received more accurate responses than the voices.
发现照片得到的反应比声音更准确。
In the second experiment, subjects listened to nine recorded words spoken in different tones of voice.
在第二个实验中，实验对象听了9个录音以不同的声音调。
Three words had positive meanings (e.g. honey), three were neutral (e.g. oh), and three were negative (e.g. terrible).
三个字具有积极含义(例如蜂蜜)，三个字是中性的(例如，Oh)，三个词是消极的(例如，可怕的)。
Again, the subjects had to guess the speaker’s emotions.
也不得不猜测演讲者的情绪。
It was found that tone of voice carried more meaning than the individual words.
人们发现，声音的语气比单词更有意义。

From these experiments the researchers concluded that 7% of our feeling towards a speaker is based on the actual words they use, 38% on their tone of voice, and 55% on their body language (e.g. facial expression).
从这些实验中，研究人员得出结论，我们对于扬声器的7%的感觉是基于他们实际使用的单词，38%基于他们的声音音调，55%基于他们的身体语言(例如面部表达)。

paragraphs.brief: 然而，仔细研究研究后发现，存在一些局限性。
sentences: However, a closer look at the study reveals several limitations.
然而，仔细研究研究后发现，存在一些局限性。
The first is that the entire study involved only 62 subjects.
第一，整个研究只涉及62个科目。
Of these, 25 were used to select the word for the first experiment, while the key issue – comparing verbal and non-verbal communication – was determined by only the 37 remaining subjects.
其中25个用于为第一次试验选择词，而关键问题——比较口头和非口头交流——则仅由其余37个主题决定。
All were female undergraduates who participated as part of their introductory psychology course, and their ages and academic qualifications seem remarkably uniform.
全部都是作为入门心理学课程一部分参加课程的女本科生，她们的年龄和学历似乎非常一致。
Thus, the findings may simply be a product of the nature of the sample.
因此，调查结果可能只是样本性质的产物。

paragraphs.brief: 批评者们还指出，7-38-55公式存在缺陷，因为它是由两个不同的实验拼凑在一起的，而这两个实验都没有涉及所有三个渠道(语言、声音和面部)。
sentences: Critics have also pointed out that the 7–38–55 formula is flawed since it was pieced together from two different experiments, neither of which involved all three channels (verbal, vocal, and facial).
批评者们还指出，7-38-55公式存在缺陷，因为它是由两个不同的实验拼凑在一起的，而这两个实验都没有涉及所有三个渠道(语言、声音和面部)。
In addition, in the first experiment the single word “maybe” was used throughout so it was impossible for the effects of changes in verbal input to be assessed.
此外，在第一次试验中，始终使用“可能”一词，因此无法评估口头输入变化的影响。
The researchers intentionally used a “neutral” word so naturally the subjects found little meaning there.
研究人员有意使用“中立”一词，因此自然发现主体在那里没有什么意义。
Clearly, such a methodology lacks validity.
显然，这种方法缺乏有效性。
In the real world, people communicate in a particular context and speak in phrases and full-blown sentences, making extensive use of the multi-faceted vehicle of language.
在现实世界中，人们在特定背景下进行交流，用词句和句子说话，广泛使用多面语言工具。

paragraphs.brief: 我担心的是，对这项研究的解释在我们教学文献中占据如此突出的地位。
sentences: My concern is that interpretations of this study have gained such prominence in our pedagogical literature.
我担心的是，对这项研究的解释在我们教学文献中占据如此突出的地位。
This 7–38–55 formula appears in many basic texts, used for training in public speaking, interpersonal communication, and organizational communication.
这一7-38-55公式出现在许多基本文本中，用于公共演讲、人际交流和组织交流方面的培训。

paragraphs.brief: 显然，马拉比亚研究的一个令人感兴趣的方面是其数字精确度。
sentences: Clearly, one appealing aspect of the Mehrabian study is its numerical precision.
显然，马拉比亚研究的一个令人感兴趣的方面是其数字精确度。
Communication is a complex phenomenon, but it seems less so when we can rely on these three magical numbers.
通信是一个复杂的现象，但当我们可以依赖这三个神奇的数字时，它似乎就不太那么重要了。
In contrast to the ambiguities of language, numbers seem to possess exactness.
与语言模糊相反，数字似乎有确切性。
And the popular appeal of the study has given the 7–38–55 formula enormous credibility.
研究的流行吸引力给了7 - 38 - 55公式巨大的可信度。

There is a certain mystique about non-verbal communication, and the continued references to this research sustain it, encouraging people to believe in the overwhelming importance of the non-verbal message compared with the verbal one.
对于非口头交流有某种神秘感，继续提到这一研究，鼓励人们相信非口头信息与口头信息相比具有压倒性重要性。
Yet we know that even one ill-chosen word to a colleague or friend can make or break a communicative effort.
然而，我们知道，即使是对同事或朋友的错误选择，也能作出或打破沟通努力。
Words do matter.
语言确实重要。

Bradley (1991), one of the few textbook writers to criticize the Mehrabian study, makes the same point when he observes, “If we could communicate 93% of information and attitudes with vocal and facial cues, it would be wasteful to spend time learning a language.”
布拉德利(Bradley (1991))是批评Mehrabian研究的少数教科书作者之一，他在评论“如果我们能用声音和面部提示来传达93%的信息和态度，那么花时间学习一种语言是浪费的。”

paragraphs.brief: Mehrabian本人认为他的研究不应该被解释为贬低语言在沟通中的作用,
sentences: Mehrabian himself believes his research should not be interpreted to devalue the role of language in communication, saying:
Mehrabian本人认为他的研究不应该被解释为贬低语言在沟通中的作用,

paragraphs.brief: 请记住，我的所有发现... 涉及到感情和态度的沟通... 暗示或暗示所有交流的口头部分仅构成7%的信息，显然100%的交流都是口头的。
sentences: “Please remember that all my findings… dealt with communications of feelings and attitudes… it is absurd to imply or suggest that the verbal portion of all communication constitutes only 7% of the message… anytime we communicate abstract relationships (e.g., x = y – the square of z) clearly 100% of the entire communication is verbal.”
请记住，我的所有发现... 涉及到感情和态度的沟通... 暗示或暗示所有交流的口头部分仅构成7%的信息，显然100%的交流都是口头的。
(Mehrabian, 1995)
(Mehrabian，1995年)

paragraphs.brief: 许多教科书作者试图忠实于Mehrabian的研究背景。
sentences: To be fair, many textbook writers attempt to be faithful to the context of Mehrabian’s research.
许多教科书作者试图忠实于Mehrabian的研究背景。

For example, Stewart and D’Angelo (1988) write: “Mehrabian argues that when we’re uncertain about what someone’s feeling, or about how much we like him or her, we rely… only 7% on the words that are spoken.”
例如，Stewart和D'Angelo(1988年)写道：“Mehrabian认为，当我们对某人的感受或我们对他或她的爱好感到不确定时，我们只依赖7%的言词。
Others try to play down the specific percentages, saying that an understanding of the general importance of non-verbal cues is more important.
其他人则试图降低具体的百分比，说了解非语言提示的普遍重要性更为重要。
Nonetheless, other textbook authors simply use the numbers without placing any limits on their meaning.
不过，其他教科书的作者只是使用数字，而没有限制其含义。

paragraphs.brief: 自从首次出版这份较小的研究报告以来，它的影响远远超过了其预期范围。
sentences: Since this relatively small study was first published it has achieved an influence far beyond its intended scope.
自从首次出版这份较小的研究报告以来，它的影响远远超过了其预期范围。

We need to put it into its proper perspective and learn some important lessons from it regarding social science research, communication pedagogy, and the forces which have created widespread misunderstanding about communication.
我们需要从正确的角度来看待这个问题，并从中吸取一些重要的教训，涉及社会科学研究、交流教育以及造成对交流的广泛误解的各种力量。

items.en: Albert Mehrabian and his colleagues carried out an influential study comparing the ________ of verbal and non-verbal communication.
items.zh: 艾伯特·梅拉比安及同事开展了一项影响深远的研究，比较言语交流和非言语交流的 ________。
items.why: “effects”最能概括两种信息对交流造成的影响。不是“characteristics/purposes”,文本未讨论特征或目的。

items.en: In both experiments, subjects had to identify the ________ being communicated by other people.
items.zh: 在两项实验中，受试者都要辨认对方正在传达的 ________。
items.why: 两个实验都要求受试者判断对方所表达的情感 (feelings)

items.en: The two main areas focused on in the first experiment were voice tones and ________, while the second focused mainly on voice tones and ____ (Q30).
items.zh: 第一项实验重点考察语调和 ________，第二项则主要考察语调和 ________（Q30）。
items.why: 第一次实验比较“语调”与“面部表情”对情感判断的相对权重。

items.en: The two main areas focused on in the first experiment were voice tones and ____ (Q29), while the second focused mainly on voice tones and ________.
items.zh: 第一项实验重点考察语调和 ________（Q29），第二项则主要考察语调和 ________。
items.why: 第二次实验比较“语调” 与词义对情感判断的影响。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

items.en: One limitation of the study was that there were too few subjects involved.
items.zh: 研究的一个局限是，所涉科目太少。
items.why: 作者开始列举局限时，首先指出整个研究仅有 62 名受试者；接下来又说明参与关键比较的人数还要更少。

items.en: The fact that the subjects in the study came from a similar background was an advantage.
items.zh: 研究报告中的主题来自类似背景这一事实是一种优势。
items.why: 受试者背景相似被视为劣势而非优势。

items.en: The two experiments should have been carried out in a different order.
items.zh: 这两项试验本应按不同顺序进行。
items.why: 作者批评两次实验各自只覆盖部分交流渠道，却被合并计算百分比。批评针对实验设计，没有说两次实验应该交换次序。

items.en: The researchers’ choice of a neutral word was helpful in the context of the study.
items.zh: 研究人员选择一个中性词对研究很有帮助。
items.why: 选择中性词被批评为削弱有效性，而非“有帮助”

items.en: The study would have been more valid if it had included a range of languages.
items.zh: 如果研究包括一系列语言，本会更加有效。
items.why: 作者指出受试者人数少，关键比较所用的人更少。文中没有讨论多用几种语言是否能提高实验效度。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: What does the writer say about the “numerical precision” of Mehrabian’s study?
items.zh: 作者对Mehrabian研究的 " 数字精确度 " 怎么说？
correct: It makes the claims more attractive.
这使得索赔更有吸引力。

items.en: What does the writer say about the popularity of the 7–38–55 formula?
items.zh: 作者对7 -38 -55公式的流行有何看法？
correct: It is leading to an undervaluing of words.

items.en: What point is Bradley making about language learning?
items.zh: 布拉德利对语言学习有什么看法？
correct: Language must be important since we make an effort to acquire it.
语言必须很重要，因为我们努力获得语言。

items.en: What does Mehrabian himself say about his findings?
items.zh: Mehrabian本人对他的调查结果怎么说？
correct: They are relevant to only one area of communication.
它们只涉及一个通信领域。

items.en: What is the writer’s purpose in the paragraph beginning “To be fair…”?
items.zh: 作者在开始"公平"的段落里的目的是什么？
correct: To present varying interpretations of Mehrabian’s study.
提出对梅拉比亚研究的不同解释。

pairs: 实验要求受试者辨认他人传达的感受，原文把这些感受称作声音和面部照片中的 emotions。
题干评价样本量太小，原文以 only 限定具体数目，指出研究仅纳入62人。
这两个词修饰的是研究结论对读者的吸引力，这种吸引力来自数字看似精确。
第 4 段 · 第 2 句
points: 作者批评两次实验各自只覆盖部分交流渠道，却被合并计算百分比。批评针对实验设计，没有说两次实验应该交换次序。
两个实验都要求受试者判断对方所表达的情感 (feelings)
clauses: “that the photos received more accurate responses than the voices”补足 found 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 found 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
All were female undergraduates …, and their ages and academic qualifications seem remarkably uniform.
“who participated as part of their introductory psychology course”修饰前面的 undergraduates。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 who 时，回看 undergraduates，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: A study of non-verbal communication carried out in 1967 continues to be widely quoted today.
1967年进行的关于非口头通信的研究今天继续被广泛引用。
David Lapakko looks at limitations in the original study.
David Lapakko在原始研究中研究了局限性。
